summary: The routing table covers every role id and the schemas validate their samples, but one acceptance criterion is unmet and the review schema's own conditional rules are untested.

findings.message: The acceptance criterion 'no model names appear in cards' is not enforced anywhere, so a later edit can reintroduce one. Add the forbidden-token assertion to the card test.

findings.message: The review schema's ACCEPT-has-no-blocking-finding rule duplicates contract.review_result(); worth a comment pointing at the single source of truth.
